Khronos PBR Neutral tone mapping

Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/ToneMapping/tree/b5a2eed5ddf6c2227090449399de9c7affb9e4c9

Orbit adapts the small PBR Neutral tone mapping function in the Metal and
GLSL character shaders. Names and syntax are changed for the two backends.
The rendering backend, lighting, geometry, and resource handling are separate
Orbit implementations. No Filament implementation code is included.
